en: Mount Pulag is the highest mountain in Luzon, whereas Mount Apo is the highest peak in the entire Philippines.
Davao City is the largest city in the Philippines by land area, not the highly urbanized City of Manila.
Mayon Volcano is a steep stratovolcano, not a gently sloping shield volcano, which gives it a perfectly symmetrical cone shape.
Baguio City experiences cold weather due to its high elevation, not because it is located in a temperate climate zone.
Laguna de Bay is the largest lake in the entire Philippines, while Lake Lanao is only the largest lake in Mindanao.
The Philippine Trench is the deepest body of water in the Philippine Sea, not the deepest part of the entire Pacific Ocean.
Palawan is geologically attached to the Asian continental shelf, not formed from the oceanic crust of the main Philippine archipelago.
The entire Philippine archipelago is located north of the equator, not directly on or south of the equator line.
The Chocolate Hills in Bohol are not volcanic cones, but are actually geological formations made of marine limestone.
Taal Volcano is not the smallest volcano in the world, but it is the second most active volcano in the Philippines.
The Cagayan River is the longest river in the Philippines, not the Pasig River which is the most historically famous.
The Banaue Rice Terraces are not naturally occurring geological formations, but were hand-carved into the mountains by the indigenous Ifugao people.
